tasks.title: Repair a parcel-pickup misunderstanding: read and notice
tasks.objective: Jusqu’à gives an end point; avant gives a boundary. Use est-ce que or a short confirmation question to check a detail instead of silently assuming it.
tasks.context: Un avis indique que le colis de Malik est disponible au point relais de la rue des Écoles jusqu’à samedi. Malik pense d’abord qu’il doit aller au bureau de poste. En relisant, il remarque le nom du commerce et vérifie son horaire. Le magasin ferme à dix-neuf heures en semaine et à dix-sept heures le samedi. L’avis demande un justificatif pour retirer le colis. Les détails de cette situation sont fictifs : il faut toujours vérifier les instructions de son propre avis.

tasks.title: Repair a parcel-pickup misunderstanding: listen and integrate
tasks.objective: Identify details, stance and limits of commitment in the scripted exchange, then integrate both sources.
tasks.context:
Original scripted exchange for listening and transcript-assisted review. One synthetic voice may perform every role; this does not demonstrate spontaneous multi-speaker comprehension.

Malik : Pardon, j’ai compris dix-neuf heures pour samedi. Employée : Dix-neuf heures en semaine, mais dix-sept heures le samedi. Malik : Donc samedi, je dois venir avant dix-sept heures ? Employée : Oui, c’est cela.

tasks.title: Repair a parcel-pickup misunderstanding: transfer and assess
tasks.objective: Transfer the module language to an unfamiliar situation and review comprehension, writing and interaction separately.
tasks.context:
Write a 90-word clarification exchange about a fictional parcel notice. Include the place, a weekday/weekend distinction and one corrected assumption. Ask the Tutor to state two similar times and confirm the right one before summarising. Do not use real parcel numbers or identification details.

Revision: retrieve the three contextual expressions without the model on a later day; correct saved errors and reuse them in a new scenario.

Review task fulfilment, source fidelity, grammar, vocabulary, organisation and interaction/repair separately. Treat spelling extraction as supported practice, not proficiency evidence.
